features: 61 Key Portable Keyboard Equipped with a Powerful and Expressive Sound Source – AiX Which Delivers a 64 Note Polyphony which Allows More Notes To Be Played. AC Adapter Included : Yes
800 Tones (43 Indian) and 250 Rhythms (39 Indian) with Dedicated Examination Tones and Rhythm Banks. Made For Students Appearing For Musical Grade Examinations, CT-X8000IN is All Grades Compatible

Equipped With a Pendrive Port which Can Be Used To Play Wav Files on Loop and Also Allows You To Save Keyboard Data. CT-X8000IN is Extremely Easy To Use, Use The Category Button To Browse Through Various Categories Of Tones/Rhythms and Navigate Using the Jog Dial Wheel or Numpad

Register Settings of Keyboard By Using The 128 Registration Memory (8 Pads X 16 Banks) Which Comes With On-Board Access To Freeze Function. Create Your Own Sound Using The Tone Editor and Make Fine Adjustments To Your Music By Using The 42 Channel Mixer
Get Access To Instant Musical Gestures Because Of The 4 Phrase Pads (25 Sets) With Recording

Advanced Rhythm Controller With 4 Variations/Fill-Ins, Features Like Sync Start/Stop, Tap Start etc Which Are Essential For Examinations. 4 Layers/Split (2 Upper and 2 Lower) Function With Transpose and Octave Shift
Use The 17 Track Recorder and Quickly Capture Your Inspiration To Create the Next Big Hit
Connect To a PC or Mac Using USB Midi Port Without Any Drivers/Installation and Create Music
6 Watts + 6 Watts Speaker Output Gives One a Clear and Strong Sound

AiX Sound Source Delivers Rich Expressiveness with 64 Note Polyphony The AiX Sound Source produces a wide range of sound qualities using the exceptional computing power of high-performance LSI. It reproduces the natural charm of acoustic instrument sounds, like the agreeable change in tone when a piano key is struck, the sensation of a drum performance, or soaring strings. The high-speed digital signal processor is applied for each sound type, like melody, backing drum, bass and organ. * This Casio CT X8000 IN Musical Keyboard image is for illustration purpose only.
